title: db.redis.apply — converge one Redis / Valkey instance (feature db.redis)
description: Converges one instance of the distribution's template unit <engine>-server@kiln-<name> (config /etc/redis/redis-kiln-<name>.conf, Valkey: /etc/valkey/valkey-kiln-<name>.conf, 0640 root:<instance group>). Each instance runs as its own system user (kiln-<engine>-<name>, created on first apply) through a drop-in /etc/systemd/system/<unit>.d/50-kiln.conf that limits writes to its data directory /var/lib/kiln-<engine>/<name> (0700) and its runtime directory. CONFIG is renamed to a random name only the agent knows; DEBUG, MODULE, SHUTDOWN, REPLICAOF, SLAVEOF, MIGRATE, ACL and MONITOR are disabled. Memory limit, eviction, password and persistence change on the running instance; a new port, bind or drop-in restarts it, after SAVE (unless persistence is none). Switching to AOF never loads a stale AOF (moved aside) and never starts empty (AOF is switched on live after a start from dump.rdb). Fails with 'port N is in use by <process>' when another process holds a new port. Waits for PING (LOADING extends the wait). Idempotent: unchanged state is a no-op only once the running process is known to use it. The stock instance on 6379 is never touched.

password.description: requirepass of the default user. Written to the config file only; redis-cli gets it through REDISCLI_AUTH

bind.description: Addresses to listen on. 127.0.0.1 is always included; absent = 127.0.0.1 only. Who can reach them is up to the firewall

persistence.description: rdb: snapshots (save 3600 1, 300 100, 60 10000); aof: append-only file, fsync every second, no snapshots; none: in memory only, every restart starts empty

changed.description: true when the configuration changed or the instance was (re)started
